sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Operating and Financial Leasing of Turbofan Aircraft Engines

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) - Non-Resident Business Corporation Regime
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: U.S.-influenced common-law statutory corporate code (Business Corporations Act, Title 19, modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law and the ABA Model Business Corporation Act) overlaid with Marshallese customary law; unitary national regime with no sub-state tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States (1986, as amended 2003)
U.S.-RMI Treaty of Amity and Economic Relations (economic provisions of the Compact)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (signed 2017, in force for the RMI)
No comprehensive BITs with EU states or mainland China and no income tax DTAAs in force (RMI levies no national income tax)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2011 (P.L. 2011-8, as amended); Banking Act 1999 (as amended); Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 19, Marshall Islands Revised Code 2014, ss. 29, 51 and 114 (registered office, registered agent and share register); Registrar of Corporations Fee Schedules; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) guidance and domestic designations; APG mutual evaluation recommendations adopted in RMI practice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified True Copy of the passport of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of residence; identity document issued by the relevant national authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille in source country; RMI consular legalization fallback where source country is not an Apostille Contracting State (RMI itself is not an HCCH contracting party, but notarized-plus-apostilled bundles are the prevailing accepted market standard)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or independent bank reference) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or regulated banking institution in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI consular legalization per source-country requirements

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-wealth confirmation for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Accredited financial institution maintaining the UBO's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI consular legalization per source-country requirements

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate due diligence bundle for any corporate shareholder: certificate of incorporation, charter, register of directors, and certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI consular legalization per source-country requirements

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified UBO declaration and registered agent AML/CFT acknowledgment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed RMI registered agent to be appointed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic RMI notarization only; no apostille required for RMI-origin documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated and manual screening of all directors, 25%+ UBOs, and senior managers against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions, and RMI FIU domestic designations; mandatory PEP classification (heads of state, ministers, senior judicial/military/civil officers, SOE executives) under AML/CFT Act 2011 s. 2 with enhanced due diligence (EDD) when any such person is a controller or UBO; adverse-media and negative-news review; re-screening triggered by sanctions-list updates or proposed bank account activation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro — Marshall Islands Corporate Registry (name reservation and clearance processed via the official registry queue and authorized RMI registered agents under BCA s. 29)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in the Latin alphabet; no Marshallese translation requirement; the name must be distinguishable from all registered names and must include 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company', or approved abbreviations (Inc., Ltd., Corp.); foreign-language names must be transliterated into Latin characters with a verified English meaning.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent must file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days, attaching a distinguishability analysis or the written consent of the holder of any similar name; if the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file a new reservation with a modified name and thereafter seek judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the RMI Administrative Procedure principles.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible and standard for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation: the BCA requires only a physical registered-office address in Majuro maintained by a licensed registered agent for service of process; there is no statutory requirement of in-territory employees, premises, or board meetings for an offshore aircraft-engine leasing BC, provided the entity derives no RMI-source revenue; virtual/agent-office substance is the prevailing market model and is accepted by banks where combined AML/CFT due diligence is satisfied.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a non-resident BC with agent-only office, estimated at approximately 5% annualized probability; unannounced inspection is legally permitted under the AML/CFT Act 2011 and Banking Act 1999, and probability rises above 25% upon a PEP alert, sanctions hit, suspicious transaction report, or UBO disclosure discrepancy.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name clearance and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under BCA Fee Schedule s. 29

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for non-resident Business Corporation (authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under BCA Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service, Majuro (first calendar year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark quoted by licensed agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional incorporation and drafting: articles of incorporation, by-laws, initial director consents, UBO register, corporate records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for offshore corporate counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP, and sanctions screening pack (2 UBOs, 2 directors, adverse-media check)
Notarization, certification, apostille and/or consular legalization of source-country documents (estimated three jurisdictions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory authentication tariffs and prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation escrow handling of subscriber funds (attorney escrow account)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for transactional escrow compliance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, 1990, as amended, of the Republic of the Marshall Islands; applicable provisions concerning Articles of Incorporation, issuance of shares, registered office and registered agent, directors, officers, and corporate records.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro; filings are submitted through a licensed resident registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (with initial Bylaws and Registered Agent Consent as ancillary statutory filings)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under RMI law; the Company may be incorporated with zero paid-up capital and shares may be issued for such consideration as the board determines. No statutory escrow account is mandated, although escrow arrangements may be adopted contractually in aviation financing documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the voluntary subscriptions of the Company's authorized common shares, as accepted by the incorporator, are ratified, approved and deemed fully taken by the initial shareholders; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company in the Republic of the Marshall Islands designated by the registered agent is adopted as the statutory registered office and place for service of process; RESOLVED, that the individuals designated by the incorporator shall serve as the initial President and Secretary-Treasurer, each with the powers vested by the Bylaws; RESOLVED, that the said officers are authorized to execute and file all documents and pay all governmental fees required to carry out these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), Majuro; filings submitted through a licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written reservation request with the proposed corporate name and two alternate names to the Registrar via the licensed registered agent. Confirm that the name is distinguishable from existing corporations on the RMI corporate register and does not imply an unlawful purpose. Pay the name-reservation fee and obtain the Registrar's conditional name clearance before filing the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request letter executed by the proposed incorporator or authorized agent
Alternate name list (at least two alternatives)
Power of attorney to the resident registered agent
AML/KYC identification of beneficial owners
Certificate of good standing of the parent shareholder, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried for similarity, submit a revised name-reservation request under an alternate name; if the objection relates to restricted words or misleading terms, file the Articles under an available permissible name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator, initial directors, and notarial officer; coordinated through the licensed RMI registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, registered office address in the Marshall Islands, name of the resident registered agent, authorized share structure, and permitted business purpose. Execute the Articles before the incorporator and initial directors, notarize signatures, and adopt the initial Bylaws. Obtain the registered agent's written consent to act as resident agent.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Initial Bylaws signed by the incorporator or initial directors
Registered Agent Consent to Appointment
Certificate of good standing of corporate shareholder, if applicable
AML/KYC records for directors, officers, and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles are rejected for defective execution or content, re-execute the corrected signature pages and resubmit; deficiencies may be cured by Certificate of Correction without loss of priority if filed within the statutory cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory filing and payment of state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filed by the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation, together with the registered agent consent and transmittal letter, to the Registrar along with the required filing fee. The filing may be delivered in person at the Registrar's office in Majuro or through the approved online corporate registry channel. The Registrar reviews the filing for formal compliance and opens the corporate record.
required_dossiers: Original Articles of Incorporation in at least three counterparts
Registered Agent Consent to Appointment
Transmittal letter with fee calculation
Wire or check payment receipt for the state filing fee
Certificate of name clearance from Step 1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of deficiency, file the specific corrective document and pay any cure fee required. Where an amendment is necessary, file a Certificate of Correction or Articles of Amendment before the prescribed deadline; the SLA resets upon submission of the completed cure package.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and initial capital subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations for certificate issuance; initial shareholders and incorporator for share subscription.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation from the Registrar. The incorporator or initial directors then record the shareholder subscription list, issue share certificates for the subscribed common shares, and deposit any paid consideration into the designated corporate operating or escrow account in accordance with the subscription agreement.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Subscription agreement executed by each initial shareholder
Share ledger and executed share certificates
Escrow agreement, if any, used by financing parties
Directors' consent to the share issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical error, return it to the Registrar for re-issuance under the Certificate of Correction procedure; if a share subscription is queried, record a board resolution ratifying the consideration received.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and pro forma governance resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial board of directors, acting by meeting or unanimous written consent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the board, or obtain a unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting, to approve the pro forma First Board Resolution. The resolution ratifies the share subscriptions, adopts the registered office and registered agent, appoints the initial President and Secretary-Treasurer, and authorizes bank and escrow account signatories. Place the executed minutes or consent in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Notice or waiver of notice of the organizational meeting
Unanimous written consent or board meeting minutes
Pro forma First Board Resolution
Officer acceptance forms
Confirmation of registered office address and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any inconsistency in the organizational resolutions is cured by a corrective unanimous written consent executed by all directors and officers and filed in the corporate record; if service of process is challenged, re-confirm the registered agent appointment with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation compliance: registered agent confirmation and annual good standing maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations and licensed RMI registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual Registered Agent Confirmation with the Registrar and pay any applicable annual good-standing or franchise fee. Maintain the corporate minute book and share register at the registered agent's office in Majuro. After the first confirmation, obtain a Certificate of Good Standing to confirm full compliance.
required_dossiers: Annual registered agent confirmation form
Receipt for any applicable good-standing or franchise tax payment
Copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Registered agent service address confirmation
Corporate minute book and share register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual filing is rejected, cure by paying late fees and resubmitting the confirmation within 10 business days; if the Company is administratively dissolved, apply for reinstatement under the RMI BCA reinstatement procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; no industrial licensing board is engaged for a pure non-resident aircraft engine dry-leasing company. If a physical facility in RMI is later established, the RMI Ministry of Natural Resources and Commerce and the RMI Environmental Protection Authority would have jurisdiction.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None; no statutory operating, manufacturing, or industrial license is required for an aircraft engine dry-leasing business engaged solely in financial asset management and non-resident leasing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt; no EIA registration is required because the activity involves no land clearing, construction, manufacturing, discharge, or fixed-plant installation in the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the registered office. No wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste handling occurs at an RMI site. If the Company later establishes an engine storage or test facility, the RMI EPA clean air and water standards and waste management regulations will apply to any point-source discharge or emissions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a non-resident dry-lessor with no physical premises or employees in the Marshall Islands. If a future office, warehouse, or engine maintenance facility is opened, the Company will be required to obtain fire safety certification, structural load inspection approval, and workplace occupational safety and health clearance from the competent RMI authorities before operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Administration (RCA), Ministry of Finance; taxpayer portal and e-services administered through the Registered Agent doorway for offshore entities (official portal: https://www.mof.gov.mh).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forms a Business Corporation (Non-Resident) under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. No income tax TIN is statutorily required for a non-resident domestic corporation deriving no income from Marshall Islands sources. If the entity engages in physical customs transactions, it must register with the RCA for customs purposes via the ASYCUDA World declaration system. If the entity employs staff in-country, it must obtain a Social Security Registration Number from the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration. No VAT ID is obtainable or required because the Marshall Islands imposes no value-added tax. The registered agent in Majuro files the incorporation certificate and any subsequent registrations through the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Election to operate as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation under Section 56 of the Business Corporations Act, which exempts all non-Marshall Islands source income from national income tax. Election to obtain an Offshore Business License category (Class 4) for internationally oriented leasing activities. No check-the-box election exists in Marshall Islands tax law; the entity is treated as an entity-level taxpayer only to the extent it derives Marshall Islands source income. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized. Foreign tax credit and treaty relief are generally unavailable because Marshall Islands does not maintain comprehensive income tax treaties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / GST / General Sales Tax; indirect taxation limited to customs import duties and ad valorem or specific excise duties at importation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Customs registration is required only for entities importing or exporting physical goods through Marshall Islands customs territory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable - no VAT/GST e-invoicing mandate exists. Customs entries are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World single-window system, with fiscal assessment at importation. There is no real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital invoice validation requirement for aircraft engine dry-leasing transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands does not impose VAT/GST, so there is no export zero-rating mechanism. Export of goods or offshore services is outside the scope of indirect taxation. For income tax purposes, income derived by a non-resident domestic corporation from the dry-leasing of aircraft engines to foreign lessees is exempt from Marshall Islands income tax if the income is not attributable to a Marshall Islands permanent establishment or source activity.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical exportation from Marshall Islands territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT confirmation evidencing receipt of lease rental proceeds in a licensed foreign or domestic bank account
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback regime exists because there is no VAT zero-rating mechanism. However, fraudulent customs declarations are subject to the Marshall Islands Customs Ordinance, including fines up to 200% of the duty evaded, forfeiture of the goods, and imprisonment up to 3 years. For income tax, the anti-avoidance provisions may recharacterize artificial or sham leasing arrangements if the economic substance of the transaction is found to be connected to Marshall Islands source activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No domestic central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The United States Dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association. Banking supervision is vested in the Banking Commissioner of the RMI Banking Commission under the Banking Act 1987; AML/CFT oversight is exercised by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility across both current and capital accounts. Because USD is the de facto domestic currency and the RMI has no exchange-control law, capital injections, lease-rental repatriations, and dividend distributions by a non-resident Business Corporation can be effected freely in USD without central-bank approval, FX licensing, or conversion permits. Practical constraints arise exclusively from AML/KYC and correspondent-bank de-risking, not from statutory FX limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. RMI imposes no export-proceeds surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation window. Lease income from aircraft-engine dry leasing (ISIC 5223) may be retained offshore, pooled, or disbursed in USD without declaration to any RMI monetary authority.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Not suitable for commercial treasury operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Global digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Mercury) generally refuse RMI-incorporated non-resident BCs due to the FATF grey-list designation (June 2024). The RMI Digital Asset Business Act offers a digital-asset licensing path but does not establish an EMI framework accepted by foreign correspondent banks. A Delaware or Wyoming US subsidiary of the BC is the recommended vehicle for fintech payment rails; alternatively, a Hong Kong or Singapore EMI may accept the BC if the UBO has a clean regulated-banking history.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily mandated, but BOMI and Bank of Guam in practice require: (i) certified apostilled constitutional documents; (ii) notarized passports of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners; (iii) a board resolution authorizing account opening with specimen signatures; and (iv) an in-person or supervised live-video KYC interview with the compliance officer. Remote onboarding is permissible only through a licensed RMI registered agent acting as an AML introducer that has conducted face-to-face verification of the principals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF grey-list status (23 June 2024) triggering enhanced due diligence and correspondent-bank de-risking
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current AML/CFT compliance certificate from the RMI FIU; independent external audit opinion under the AML/CFT Act; bank reference letters from the parent's G-SIB relationship bank; board resolution appointing a local AML compliance officer; evidence of timely submission of all suspicious-transaction reports if any.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident BC with zero domestic substance and nominee officers classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced under ISIC 5223
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent certificate and service-of-process undertaking; group organizational chart showing the BC as a special-purpose engine-lessor; full execution set of lease agreements, technical-management agreements, and insurance certificates; economic-substance narrative demonstrating board decision-making from a verifiable jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value movable assets (turbofan engines, unit values exceeding USD 5 million) creating transaction-value and trade-based money-laundering red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent teardown/valuation appraisal; engine serial-number verification; CAS registration or FAA/EASA import records; maintenance-reserve and logbook history; annotated source-and-application-of-funds statements for each engine acquisition and lease transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or director resident in a FATF-listed high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent source-of-wealth and source-of-funds forensic report by a Big-Four-adjacent firm; affidavit of tax compliance and adverse-media clearance; list of all regulated financial institutions where the UBO maintains accounts; quarterly transaction-screening undertaking and enhanced monitoring consent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans are routed entirely in USD over SWIFT using MT103 messages. Wire protocols require the purpose narrative 'ISIC 5223 engine-leasing equity injection' or 'shareholder loan'; SWIFT purpose code 'TXNR' (transaction type) with the underlying capital-account basis cited. For escrow-funded capital, a US attorney or title-company escrow account disburses via MT103 against delivery and title-transfer certificates. Verification bundle for the receiving bank: board resolution, source-of-funds evidence from the remitting entity, UBO confirmations, and an executed capital-contribution deed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 direct transfers for lease rentals, insurance premia, MRO payments, and technical-fee disbursements, each referencing the engine serial number and lease-agreement ID. Secondary rail: ICC UCP 600 Commercial Letters of Credit issued by the lessee's bank in favor of the BC for rental-security obligations, and standby LCs for performance security. Escrow accounts are used as concentration accounts to collect rentals from multiple lessees and to fund scheduled disbursements to OEMs and approved MRO providers. All outgoing wires must be pre-mapped to the approved transaction register maintained by the AML compliance officer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Standard currency forwards (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY/USD) executed on the London or New York interbank market to fix non-USD lease-rental conversions
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) offshore for lessee jurisdictions with restricted local currencies, executed via an offshore prime broker under ISDA 2002
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, GBP/USD) to convert non-USD lease receivables into USD for debt-service and distribution alignment
Interest-rate swaps (fixed-vs-floating) linked to aircraft-engine acquisition financing to hedge benchmark rate exposure
FX options (plain-vanilla calls/puts on USD pairs) to cap adverse conversion on large one-off asset-disposal proceeds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year; accepted without penalty within 30 days after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 25.00 per month or fraction thereof; continued non-payment for 60 days after written notice of default permits the Registrar to strike the corporation off the register or administratively dissolve it

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit thresholds apply to a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act; an audit is required only if imposed by an external lender, foreign regulator, or court order
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory domestic accounting framework is imposed on non-resident corporations; IFRS is the customary standard for preparing financial statements for aircraft-engine lessors and financing parties

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO filing is made to the Registrar. The registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership record under Marshall Islands AML/CFT rules and must obtain an updated confirmation from the entity upon any share transfer or material ownership change

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary audit typically USD 4,000 - USD 8,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profit tax, no gross receipt tax on non-resident-source income, no VAT/GST, and no stamp duty on share transfers. A non-resident domestic Business Corporation (BC) formed under the RMI Business Corporations Act (BCA) is tax-exempt on all income derived from outside the RMI, including lease rental income from turbofan aircraft engines physically located outside RMI airspace and operated by non-RMI air carriers. The only recurring fiscal impositions are the registration/annual report fee (a fixed BCA regulatory fee tied to authorized capital, not an income tax) and the economic substance compliance burden. A 3% gross revenue business license tax applies only to commercial activities physically conducted within the RMI; a non-resident aircraft-engine dry lessor with no RMI-source activity is outside that scope.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI has no corporate income tax return. The mandatory annual filing is the BCA Annual Report under Section 96 of the Business Corporations Act, submitted through a licensed RMI resident agent via the official e-filing portal of the Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Registry of Legal Entities), or in paper form at the Majuro Registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year (the Annual Report Date). There is no extension mechanism; a report filed after the anniversary date is late.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered legal name of the non-resident BC exactly as stated in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact English name; foreign-script names require a registered transliteration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique BC registration number assigned by the RMI Registrar of Corporations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities must reference the 'NR' designation if shown on the certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Registered Office in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (not a post office box).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed resident agent's office address (e.g., in Majuro) is mandatory; this address is the service-of-process point.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed RMI resident agent (registered agent) authorized to accept service of process.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a licensed corporate services provider; the agent counter-signs the report and maintains the statutory record book.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and addresses of all incumbent directors and the principal officers (President/CEO, Secretary, Treasurer).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permissible; no RMI citizen-director requirement exists, but each director's details are required and annually certified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital amount and number of shares, including class structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Determines the annual fee tier; a standard non-resident BC with US$50,000 authorized capital falls in the base US$200 annual fee bracket.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the corporation's nature of business, including a declaration of non-resident status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Non-Resident Domestic Corporation engaging in aircraft-engine operating lease activities outside the RMI'; confirm no RMI-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorized officer, attested by the resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Executed under penalty of misrepresentation; the resident agent verifies identity and good standing before lodging.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the anniversary date triggers delinquency proceedings: a delinquent corporation may not transact business, maintain legal standing to sue, or obtain certified documents in the RMI. The Registrar may revoke the certificate of registration after continued delinquency (typically after 60 days), requiring a formal reinstatement, payment of all back annual fees, and a late penalty of US$100 per year of delinquency. Directors who transact business in the corporation's name after revocation incur joint and several personal liability for debts so incurred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR Return) prescribed under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2020, submitted through the licensed RMI resident agent into the government-designated ESR e-filing system administered by the Registrar of Corporations. Aircraft-engine dry leasing is classified as a 'Finance and Leasing' relevant activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six (6) months after the end of the accounting period. For a calendar-year entity, the return is due no later than June 30 of the following year. A shorter transitional period applies in the first year of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, registration number, RMI registered office, resident agent, and accounting period end date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident BC must identify itself as the registered entity and specify whether it is relying on RMI tax residence or foreign tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Category of relevant activity conducted during the accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Finance and Leasing'; describe the business as dry leasing of turbofan aircraft engines to airlines under operating/finance lease agreements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of where the entity is tax resident.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the BC is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction (e.g., a shareholder jurisdiction), attach written evidence from that jurisdiction's tax authority; an excluded entity is relieved of RMI ESR substance requirements for that period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section 4 - Income and RMI Tax Status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from the relevant activity and statement of tax charge in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare lease rental income and confirm that RMI does not levy income tax on it; the entity remains subject to ESR despite paying zero tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical premises in the RMI from which the activity is directed and number of local employees (including outsourced arrangements).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A registered office alone is insufficient; the entity needs a substantive local presence, typically satisfied through a licensed RMI corporate services provider that supplies local staff, board administration, and meeting facilities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Detailed statement of where and how the leasing business is managed and decisions are taken.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose that lease negotiation, lease structuring, engine acquisition decisions, ongoing lease monitoring, invoice management, and risk management occur in the RMI either by local employees or by the local director body.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that accounting records, board minutes, and lease documentation are maintained in the RMI and available for inspection.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a paperless/maillbox operation, this is the critical failure point; records must be physically retrievable in the RMI.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or false filing triggers escalating sanctions: an initial penalty of up to US$10,000; continued non-compliance a further penalty of up to US$20,000; and for serious offenses, a penalty of up to US$100,000 plus possible strike-off of the entity and, for individuals knowingly causing the offense, imprisonment of up to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - The RMI does not impose any withholding tax on dividend distributions by a Business Corporation to its shareholders, whether resident or non-resident, individual or corporate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The RMI has not concluded any comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) or OECD income tax treaty. The RMI's only international instruments are tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs), notably with the United States, and the US FATCA Model 1 intergovernmental agreement. There is therefore no treaty withholding relief mechanism for RMI dividends and no RMI tax residence certificate for income tax purposes because no income tax is levied. As a practical substitute, for counterparties or foreign revenue authorities requiring proof of status, obtain: (i) the Certificate of Good Standing issued by the RMI Registrar of Corporations, (ii) a Certified Copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, and (iii) a notarized attestation letter from the licensed RMI resident agent confirming the entity's non-resident domestic status and the absence of RMI-source income. These documents, rather than an income tax TRC, are the operative instruments for supporting tax-exempt treatment in the remittance corridor.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on interest and IP royalties paid by an RMI BC to non-residents; no treaty rates are applicable because the RMI has no comprehensive tax treaty network. Lease rental payments made by an airline lessee to the RMI BC are not subject to RMI withholding or gross revenue tax provided the engines remain outside the RMI. Intercompany interest on debt funding injected into the BC is likewise free of RMI withholding tax. Foreign taxation of such flows is governed solely by the recipient's domestic law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the RMI has no transfer pricing legislation, no Local File, Master File, or CbC reporting regime, and no statutory threshold triggering documentation. The absence of a corporate income tax makes transfer pricing irrelevant for RMI domestic purposes. However, for a non-resident BC that is part of a multinational engine-leasing group, the shareholder's home jurisdiction (or the lessee airline's jurisdiction) may independently require arm's length lease pricing and documentation; contemporaneous benchmarking of third-party engine lease rates should be maintained for external foreign tax defense and to support the ESR CIGA narrative.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP - Comparable Uncontrolled Price (preferred for standardized engine lease rates)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2020 (ESR) apply. Aircraft-engine dry leasing constitutes 'Finance and Leasing' business, which is a relevant activity under the Regulations. An RMI BC engaged in this activity must satisfy a two-pronged test: (i) it must not be a pure 'maillbox' structure, and (ii) it must maintain adequate economic substance in the RMI, namely a physical registered office, a substantive local presence (premises and staff, either directly employed or outsourced to a licensed RMI corporate services provider), and effective control and management exercised in the RMI. The core income-generating activities - negotiating lease terms, approving transactions, managing and monitoring the lease portfolio, and bearing and managing aeronautical risk - must be performed in the RMI. If the entity proves it is a tax resident of a recognized foreign jurisdiction and supplies written evidence from that jurisdiction's tax authority, it is excluded from RMI ESR obligations. Otherwise, annual ESR filing and substance maintenance are mandatory; non-compliance exposes the entity to fines, strike-off, and criminal liability of directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Registry Delinquency and Trading After Dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the BCA Annual Report before the anniversary of incorporation, causing the Registrar to declare the BC delinquent and revoke its registration, followed by continued execution of engine lease agreements, issuance of SWIFT wire payment instructions, or maintenance of escrow accounts in the corporation's name without valid legal existence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the certificate of registration; automatic incapacity to contract, sue, or hold property in the RMI; reinstatement conditioned on payment of all unpaid annual fees plus a late penalty of US$100 for each delinquent year; possible administrative strike-off and loss of the RMI corporate veil for all acts occurring after revocation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who transact business after revocation are jointly and severally personally liable for all contractual debts and tort liabilities incurred in the corporation's name. Courts may impose civil restitution in favor of aggrieved lessees or creditors; directors may also face travel bans if they leave the jurisdiction while criminal or recovery proceedings are pending.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure (ESR Breach)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an aircraft-engine dry-leasing company through an RMI BC with no premises, no local bookkeeping, no locally administered bank or escrow oversight, no board meetings in the RMI, and no documented performance of CIGA, while nevertheless claiming RMI non-resident status; falsely declaring compliance on the ESR Return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2020: penalty of up to US$10,000 for initial non-compliance; up to US$20,000 for continued default; up to US$100,000 and strike-off for serious offenses. The regulator may also compel production of lease portfolio records, freeze assets, and notify the lessee's home tax authority via international information exchange.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and senior officers who knowingly cause or allow a false ESR declaration or who manage a shell with no substance face personal fines, disqualification from serving as directors of any RMI corporation, and imprisonment of up to 5 years. RMI courts will pierce the corporate veil where the BC is found to be an instrumentality of the shareholder, exposing directors to civil restitution and repatriation of diverted lease rental income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Misrepresentation to Foreign Tax Authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI BC to conceal the economic ownership of lease income from the revenue authorities of the beneficial owner's home state; backdating lease or novation agreements; misstating lease income as capital; issuing false invoices; submitting false beneficial-ownership declarations to the RMI resident agent or Registrar; or refusing to respond to TIEA requests under the RMI-USA information exchange arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI law treats false statements in statutory filings as misrepresentation punishable by criminal penalties including fines and imprisonment at the discretion of the court. The RMI will cooperate with foreign authorities under its TIEA network by compelling production of bank and ledger records; the US may impose a 30% FATCA withholding penalty on any US-sourced engine lease payments if the entity fails its FATCA/IGA obligations, and foreign tax authorities may recharacterize the structure as a sham and assess taxes, penalties, and interest against the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors who execute false declarations or knowingly facilitate the evasion scheme are personally liable for criminal fines, restitution of evaded tax, and imprisonment. Travel bans and asset freezes may be issued in support of extradition or mutual legal assistance requests; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud, making shareholders and directors personally answerable for the full tax deficiency.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Proliferation Financing in the Lease-Rent Escrow Flow
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving engine lease rental payments through SWIFT wire and escrow accounts without maintaining beneficial-ownership records; layering lease payments through multiple shell entities; accepting payments from sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions; structuring transactions to avoid the US$10,000 reporting threshold; or failing to report suspicious transactions to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit. This conduct breaches the RMI Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act and the RMI's international AML/CFT commitments under the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering is a criminal offense in the RMI punishable by substantial fines and imprisonment of up to 10 years, plus forfeiture of the aircraft engines, lease receivables, and escrowed funds. The regulator may suspend the licensed resident agent that facilitated the non-compliant structure and may cancel the BC's registration. Foreign correspondent banks may terminate the escrow and SWIFT relationships, effectively freezing the entity's payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who direct or knowingly benefit from the laundering scheme face personal criminal prosecution, asset confiscation, and civil liability for the full amount of tainted lease income. Where the escrow account was used as a conduit for third-party money laundering, courts will impose imprisonment, travel bans, and permanent disqualification from acting as a director of any RMI or foreign company.
